properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 22 at 10:44AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
At 1044 AM PDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
West Covina, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Glendora...
West Covina...
Baldwin Park...
Azusa...
Falling Springs...
Angeles Crest Highway between Mount Wilson and Mount Waterman...
Arcadia...
Sierra Madre...
Monrovia...
Covina...
El Monte...
Irwindale...
Temple City...
and Duarte.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

NWSheadline: A STRONG THUNDERSTORM WILL IMPACT EAST CENTRAL LOS ANGELES COUNTY THROUGH 1115 AM PDT
